scope_note: Execution/provenance only; alert membership and validity owned by other lanes. Prior result count was diff-informed, not a complete repository inventory. Severity configuration override not exposed in inspected APIs; documented default only.
scope_limits: The required findings check reports 265 alerts; its annotation API exposes 100. The other inventories do not prove exact membership.
An analysis job succeeding is not a findings check passing.
Neither the expanded result count nor membership in a static scan proves a runtime vulnerability.
No new alert dismissals are authorized or performed. Prior approvals cover 11587,11588,11594 only.
